messages.subject: Applying sampling weights in lavaan
parts:
Dear All, 

I was wondering if the lavaan package can apply survey weights? 

If that is not an option, I saw there is package called  lavaan.survey, but I'm not really familiar with the program. Can it estimate your models using the cfa() or sem() function as well? 

Thanks in advance, 

Josephine.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Applying sampling weights in lavaan
parts:
On 06/04/2014 01:30 PM, Josephine Foubert wrote:
> Thank you for the quick response. To check if I understand it correctly:
>
> - The lavaan.survey package can implement the sample weights, but only
> handles continuous variables at the moment?

Endogenous continuous variables only. If you have only exogenous
categorical covariates, that is not a problem.

> - If I also want to include categorical variables in the analysis, I
> will have to use lavaan, but the package does not yet handle survey
> weights?

If you have endogenous categorical variables, you can NOT use the
lavaan.survey package. (Note that this is a limitation of the original
survey package.)
> (Will this be implemented in future versions?)

Eventually, yes. But it is not a priority.

Yves.
